case: Grid edits preserve nonnumeric TEXT in numeric-affinity columns
contract: The app grid parser sends nonnumeric input as TEXT for SQLite INTEGER, REAL, and NUMERIC columns; MySQL and SQL Server keep strict numeric rejection for the same input.
SQLite native typeof() confirms the edited values are TEXT in all three columns, while an untouched sibling row retains its native INTEGER/REAL kinds and exact values.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib ui::browse_tab::value_parse::tests::sqlite_numeric_affinity_grid_edit_preserves_text_and_sibling_values -- --exact --test-threads=1

app_library_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --lib

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other storage-class and affinity combinations and installed editing remain open; this case does not close B3 or qualify 0.2.0.
